content: Tua ahikom ka thuakzawk nawn ngawl uh ciang in, keima bek Athens ah tang leng pha tu hi, ci in ka ngaisun uh hi;
Taciang i suapui pa, Pathian naseam le Christ i lungdamna thupha sungah ka naseppui uh Timothy sia note kipsak tu le note i upna taw kisai in note heneam tu in kong paisak uh hi:
Tabang in hi haksatna hu in kuama hong lok bua tu hi: banghangziam cile kote sia hi haksatna te thuak tu in a ciangtan sate ka hi uh hi, ci sia note mama in na he uh hi.
Banghangziam cile note kungah ka om uh lai in, haksatna ka thuak tu uh hi, ci sia mantak in hong son zo khu hi; kong son uh bangma in hong theng takpi hi, ci na he uh hi.
Hi thu hang in, ka thuak zawk ngawl uh ciang in, na up thei natu uh in Timothy kong paisak uh hi, tabang hi bale, ze-et pa in hong ze-et tu a, ka nasepna uh te a luithathong suak tu hi.

Ahihang tu in Timothy sia note kung pan kote kungah hong theng zo hi, taciang na upna uh le itna lungdamna thupha hong puak hi, taciang note in phatak in tatsat ngawl nong phawk uh a, kote in note kong mu nop uh bangma in, nong mu nuam takpi uh hi:
Tua ahikom, suapui te awng, na upna uh tungtawn in ka haksatna uh le ka thinngimna uh theampo sungah nong heneam uh hi:
Banghangziam cile, note Topa sungah kiptak in na ding uh ahile, tu in kote ka nungta uh hi.
I Pathian mai ah note hang in, ka lungdamna uh theampo atu in, Pathian tungah bang pokna te ka pia kik tu uh ziam?
Note upna a ki samlai te a kicin thei natu ahizong, na maitang ka mu thei natu uh ahizong, sun le zan in nasiatak in thu ka ngen tawntung uh hi.
Tu in i Pa Pathian ama vateak le i Topa Jesus Christ in note omna kong paina ka lampi uh ah hong makai tahen.
Taciang kote in note kong it uh bang in, note khat le khat ahizong, mi theampo tung ahizong, Topa in itna sungah khang in hong pungsak tahen:
I Topa Jesus Christ sia a mithiangtho theampo taw hongpai ciang in, na thinsung uh te i Pa Pathian mai ah pauban na om ngawl, thianthona taw a tawpdong in hong kipsak tahen.
